descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S19 「iPhone 和 Android 上的真人语音，先 Wi-Fi 再蜂窝网络，两个模式，记录引擎」 Real voice on iPhone and Android, on Wi-Fi and then on cellular, both modes, engine recorded

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Dictated numbers (doses, lab values, vital signs) are transcribed exactly: same value, nothing dropped, added or changed.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 3）
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 4）
  • U3 A dictated Celsius temperature stays in Celsius: no conversion to Fahrenheit, no change of unit.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 5）
  • U4 U1-U3 hold on both Wi-Fi and cellular.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 6）
  • U5 The speech-to-text engine used is recorded for every run (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when the ambient option is on), alongside the note model.（UAT TC-23；UAT 3.9；TFA-94423 AC 7）
  • U6 Run as an AI check on at least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passing at 9/10 or better with every failure quoted, and passing in both modes.（UAT 3.2；UAT 3.3）
  • U9 Dictation behaves the same whatever the device clock or time zone: a phone with a wrong clock, no clock set or another time zone gets the same result as any other device.（UAT 3.8）
  • T1 GPT-live is the active dictation engine on every platform (no on-device or native recogniser on phones either, Daniela 2026-10-09), routed server-side, with no API key in the browser.（TFA-94423 AC 1；TFA-94423 latest decision (Daniela 2026-10-09)）
  • T4 Native microphone dictation works on iOS and Android and survives a phone call, backgrounding or a screen lock with no text lost.（TFA-92570 AC 3；TFA-92570 AC 5）
  • T5 TC-23 passes as a UAT AI check per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md.（TFA-94229 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given Deployed build (UAT §4) on a real iPhone and a real Android phone, @roundai.test account, synthetic patients; run by a person, not by this agent

When Read the ten sentences H-01…N-05 aloud into the pre-round boxes (Hospital half, Nursing Home half) on Wi-Fi; switch Wi-Fi off and repeat on cellular; repeat the Hospital half once on a phone set to the wrong date (3.8)

Then Every sentence passes its S01/S02 checks on both networks and both platforms; the engine for each take is read from the AI call log after each take; the wrong-date phone gives the same result as the others

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：The tester applies the S01/S02 checks (numbers, boundaries, occurrences) to each box and quotes every failing transcript; scored per mode (x/5) and per network and platform, with the 9/10 pooled (3.2, 3.3, Q4, Q5). Engine per take from diagnostics read after each take (8-row limit; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
